local function gripWorld(p123, p124, p125) -- Line: 381
    if not (p123 and p123.Parent) then

    end;

    end;

            return (p125 * child.C0 * (child:IsA("Motor6D") and child.Transform or CFrame.identity) * child.C1:Inverse() * p123.CFrame).Position;

    return p123.WorldPosition;
end;

local function bagData(p166) -- Line: 461

        return nil, "";
    end;

    };

local function fadeTree(p173, p174) -- Line: 481
    -- upvalues: u172 (copy)
    local v175 = 1 - p174;

        local v176 = descendant;

                    v176:SetAttribute(v[1], Attribute);
                end;

                v176[v[2]] = Attribute + (1 - Attribute) * v175;
            end;
        end;
    end;
end;

function u3.UpdateMannequin(p323, p324) -- Line: 925
    -- upvalues: mannequinSig (copy)
    if not p324 then
        return;
    end;

    local os_clock_ret = os.clock();

    if p324 ~= p323.manChar or not (p323.manPairs and (os_clock_ret - (p323.manCheckAt or 0) <= 0.2 or mannequinSig(p324) == p323.manSig)) then
        p323:BuildMannequin(p324);

        return;
    end;

    if os_clock_ret - (p323.manCheckAt or 0) > 0.2 then
        p323.manCheckAt = os_clock_ret;
    end;

    local manRoot = p323.manRoot;

    if not (manRoot and manRoot.Parent) then
        return;
    end;

    local v325 = manRoot.CFrame:Inverse();

    for _, v in ipairs(p323.manPairs) do
        if v[1].Parent then
            v[2].CFrame = p323.manBase * (v325 * v[1].CFrame);
        end;
    end;
end;

    end;

local function gunModel(p250, p251, p252) -- Line: 626
    -- upvalues: TPS (copy), mod (copy)
    local WeaponAssets = TPS:FindFirstChild("WeaponAssets");

    if WeaponAssets then
        WeaponAssets = WeaponAssets:FindFirstChild((tostring(p251)));
    end;

    if not WeaponAssets then
        return nil;
    end;

    local v253 = WeaponAssets:Clone();

    for _, descendant in ipairs(v253:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            descendant.Anchored = true;
        end;

        if descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
            descendant:Destroy();
        end;
    end;

    if type(p252) == "string" and (p252 ~= "" and p252 ~= "Default") then
        local v254 = mod("Skins");

        if v254 and v254.Apply then
            pcall(v254.Apply, v253, p251, p252);
        end;
    end;

    v253.Parent = p250;

    return v253;
end;

local function aim(p255, p256, p257, p258) -- Line: 642
    local BoundingBox, v259 = p256:GetBoundingBox();
    local v260 = p256:IsA("Model") and p256.PrimaryPart or p256:FindFirstChild("Handle", true);
    local RightVector = BoundingBox.RightVector;
    local UpVector = BoundingBox.UpVector;

    if v260 and v260:IsA("BasePart") then
        RightVector = v260.CFrame.RightVector;
        UpVector = v260.CFrame.UpVector;
    end;

    if p258 then
        RightVector = -RightVector or RightVector;
    end;

    local Camera = Instance.new("Camera");

    for i, v in pairs({
        FieldOfView = 20
    }) do
        Camera[i] = v;
    end;

    if p255 then
        Camera.Parent = p255;
    end;

    local CFrame_lookAt_ret = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), RightVector, UpVector);
    local RightVector2 = CFrame_lookAt_ret.RightVector;
    local UpVector2 = CFrame_lookAt_ret.UpVector;
    local v261 = (1 / 0);
    local v262 = (-1 / 0);
    local v263 = (1 / 0);
    local v264 = (-1 / 0);

    for _, v in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
        local v265 = v;

        for _, v2 in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
            local v266 = v2;

            for _, v3 in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
                local v267 = BoundingBox * Vector3.new(v259.X * v265, v259.Y * v266, v259.Z * v3) - BoundingBox.Position;
                local v268 = v267:Dot(RightVector2);
                local v269 = v267:Dot(UpVector2);
                v263 = math.min(v263, v268);
                v264 = math.max(v264, v268);
                v261 = math.min(v261, v269);
                v262 = math.max(v262, v269);
            end;
        end;
    end;

    local v270 = math.max((v264 - v263) / 0.985 / p257, (v262 - v261) / 0.9) / 2;
    local math_rad_ret = math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2);
    local v271 = v270 / math.tan(math_rad_ret);
    local v272 = BoundingBox.Position + RightVector2 * ((v263 + v264) / 2) + UpVector2 * ((v261 + v262) / 2);
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(v272 - RightVector * v271, v272, UpVector);
    p255.CurrentCamera = Camera;
end;

            local Attribute2 = child:GetAttribute("LP");

            if Attribute and (Attribute2 and Attribute <= ServerTimeNow) then

                if not v144 then

                v144.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v145, v145);
            end;
        end;
    end;

    for i, v in pairs(p142.drops) do

    end;

local function fallCF(p82, p83) -- Line: 363
    -- upvalues: math_max_ret (copy)
    local v84 = p83 - p82.DT;
    local v85 = p82.LT - p82.DT;
    local math_max_ret2 = math.max(0.2, p82.Carry / p82.cSpeed);
    local math_exp_ret = math.exp(-v85 / math_max_ret2);
    local v86 = -math.min(v84, v85) / math_max_ret2;
    local v87 = (math.exp(v86) - math_exp_ret) / (1 - math_exp_ret);
    local v88 = Vector3.new(p82.LP.X, 0, p82.LP.Z) - p82.Dir * p82.Carry * v87;

    local v91 = math.clamp((v84 - 0.6) / 3, 0, 1) * 0.07 * math.clamp((v85 - v84) / 2, 0, 1);
    local CFrame_Angles_ret = CFrame.Angles(math.sin(v84 * 1.1 + p82.seed) * v91, 0, math.sin(v84 * 0.8 + p82.seed * 2) * v91);

    return v90 * CFrame.new(0, math_max_ret, 0) * CFrame_Angles_ret * CFrame.new(0, -math_max_ret, 0);
end;

local function track(p73, p74) -- Line: 218
    if p74 <= p73[1][1] then
        local v75 = p73[1];

        return v75[2], v75[3], v75[4];
    end;

    for i = 2, #p73 do
        local v76 = p73[i - 1];
        local v77 = p73[i];

        if p74 <= v77[1] then
            local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp((p74 - v76[1]) / (v77[1] - v76[1]), 0, 1);
            local v78 = math_clamp_ret * math_clamp_ret * (3 - 2 * math_clamp_ret);

            return v76[2] + (v77[2] - v76[2]) * v78, v76[3] + (v77[3] - v76[3]) * v78, v76[4] + (v77[4] - v76[4]) * v78;
        end;

        local _ = i;
    end;

    local v79 = p73[#p73];

    return v79[2], v79[3], v79[4];
end;

function u70.rootAt(p89) -- Line: 232
    -- upvalues: Beats (copy), Giant (copy)
    local v90;

    if p89 < Beats.Rise then
        v90 = -340;
    elseif p89 < Beats.Rise + 16 then
        local Rise = Beats.Rise;
        local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp((p89 - Rise) / (Beats.Rise + 16 - Rise), 0, 1);
        v90 = -340 + 480 * (1 - (1 - math.clamp(math_clamp_ret, 0, 1)) ^ 3);
    elseif p89 < Beats.Sink + 2 then
        v90 = math.sin(p89 * 0.8) * 1.5 + 140;
    else
        local v91 = Beats.Sink + 2;
        local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp((p89 - v91) / (Beats.Sink + 13 - v91), 0, 1);
        local math_clamp_ret2 = math.clamp(math_clamp_ret, 0, 1);
        v90 = 140 - 520 * (math_clamp_ret2 * math_clamp_ret2 * math_clamp_ret2);
    end;

    local Vector3_new_ret = Vector3.new(Giant.X, v90, Giant.Z);

    return CFrame.lookAt(Vector3_new_ret, Vector3_new_ret + Vector3.new(0.4110219, 0, 0.9116255));
